# Family Office Knowledge Graph

> One record per family office, drawn from the public record: the GLEIF spine first, then the national registers that fill and confirm it. Every field carries where it came from, who read it, when, and its state. Nothing is inferred and nothing is typed.

Operator: Agentic KG Holdings · Principal: Matthew Keddy · Office: https://agent-kg.ai · Surface: https://familyofficeknowledgegraph.ai · Surface version 0.19.10 · as of 2026-09-14

## What it is

A knowledge graph of the office's kind (FO_START_ME_UP_3): one Family Office Record (FOR) per subject. Field = { value, source_url, read_by, read, state } — second_source_url, second_read_by where two independent public sources agree. States: sourced · filled · confirmed · conflict · unverified. Passes: harvest → fill → confirm. Records are confirmed, not signed.

## Doors

- Apex door (MCP, streamable-http): https://mcp.fo-kg.ai/mcp — holds the index, forwards to the node door · card https://familyofficeknowledgegraph.ai/.well-known/mcp.json · node doors <node>.fo-kg.ai/mcp (ca.fo-kg.ai … row.fo-kg.ai) · long names keep answering (https://mcp.familyofficeknowledgegraph.ai/mcp, <node>.familyofficeknowledgegraph.ai/mcp, https://agent.familyofficeknowledgegraph.ai)
- Node doors: https://ae.fo-kg.ai/mcp · https://au.fo-kg.ai/mcp · https://ca.fo-kg.ai/mcp · https://ch.fo-kg.ai/mcp · https://de.fo-kg.ai/mcp · https://dk.fo-kg.ai/mcp · https://es.fo-kg.ai/mcp · https://fr.fo-kg.ai/mcp · https://it.fo-kg.ai/mcp · https://lu.fo-kg.ai/mcp · https://nl.fo-kg.ai/mcp · https://no.fo-kg.ai/mcp · https://row.fo-kg.ai/mcp · https://sg.fo-kg.ai/mcp · https://uk.fo-kg.ai/mcp · https://us.fo-kg.ai/mcp — serve the records
- Tools (five, same names on every office graph): resolve_family_office(identifier) · get_record(identifier, version?) · list_events_since(identifier, since?, cursor?, limit?) · list_aliases(identifier) · list_nodes()
- Agent Card (A2A): https://agent.fo-kg.ai/.well-known/agent-card.json
- Over HTTP: https://familyofficeknowledgegraph.ai/resolve/{identifier} · https://familyofficeknowledgegraph.ai/records/nodes.json · https://familyofficeknowledgegraph.ai/records/<node>/index.json · https://familyofficeknowledgegraph.ai/records/<node>/<LEI>.json
- Paid door (x402 v2, $0.01 USDC, Base mainnet): GET https://familyofficeknowledgegraph.ai/api → 402 offer; with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → { receipt, statement, data } = the graph index of record signed (kid fo-kg-x402-2026-09); human door https://familyofficeknowledgegraph.ai/x402; doctrine https://agent-kg.ai/x402
- Licensed route: GET https://familyofficeknowledgegraph.ai/licensed/index with a Bearer token from the office authorization server (https://agent-kg.ai/oauth/token, scope office:read); protected-resource metadata https://familyofficeknowledgegraph.ai/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource; instructions https://familyofficeknowledgegraph.ai/auth.md
- Human contact: https://familyofficeknowledgegraph.ai/#contact — the form is the only door on the page
